purpose: Measure the market response after a completed-bar boundary excursion instead of treating every breakout as continuation.

event_clock.event_formation: bars t-2 through t are completed
event_clock.first_fill: first positive-spread executable BID/ASK open strictly after decision_time

counterparty_response_surface: signed boundary excursion divided by causal ATR
area outside the boundary across three completed bars
opposing-wick absorption multiplied by causal volume anomaly
spread shock and completed-bar spread recovery
path_torsion_reclaim: signed triangle area of the last three normalized closes
turning angle between pre-break, excursion, and reclaim vectors
distance from the causal session price centroid

cost_arms.RAW_SIGNAL: generate every structural event without consulting cost
cost_arms.EXECUTABLE_BASE: apply observed BID/ASK, 0.3 pip one-way slippage, and frozen financing after signal generation
cost_arms.ADVERSE_STRESS: apply 0.9 pip one-way slippage, 0.2 bp commission one-way, and adverse financing after signal generation

selection_control.family_definition: two fixed models times three fixed horizons

automatic_rejection: proposal density collapses because of a cost gate
positive result depends on terminal open inventory
gross edge vanishes after currency-time clustering
only an opened diagnostic period is positive
result requires leverage change after outcomes are known
lookahead or same-bar ambiguous fill is detected
